chapters.5.meaning: Naaman receives help from people with less power. A captive girl and servants guide his choices.
chapters.6.meaning: Elisha feeds captured enemies and sends them home. A later siege brings hunger to Samaria.
chapters.7.meaning: Four men find food outside the city. They decide the hungry people must hear the news.
chapters.10.lds: The older Church manual questions Jehu's motives.
chapters.11.meaning: Jehosheba and a nurse save Joash before he becomes king. Their hidden care protects his life.
chapters.12.meaning: Temple repairs stall until the payment system changes. Trusted workers then use the money for repairs.
chapters.21.lds: Manasseh reverses many of Hezekiah's changes. How do a leader's choices affect other people?
chapters.25.meaning: Babylon destroys the temple and takes people away. Later kindness gives the captive king some relief.
chapters.3.meaning: The alliance wins battles but withdraws after Mesha sacrifices his son. The ending raises questions about wrath.
chapters.23.meaning: Josiah removes worship objects and renews Passover. Judah's later kings return to the practices he opposed.
people.edom-king.meaning: He joins Israel and Judah against Moab. Their armies face a shortage of water.
people.baal-shalishah-donor.meaning: He brings bread and grain that Elisha shares with a hundred people.
people.elisha-dothan-servant.meaning: He fears the surrounding army. Elisha prays, and he sees heavenly protection.
people.athaliah.meaning: She attacks the royal heirs and takes power. Joash's rescue leaves one heir alive.
people.jehu-messenger.meaning: Elisha sends him to anoint Jehu. He gives the message in private and leaves quickly.
people.joash-nurse.meaning: She stays with Joash when Jehosheba hides him from Athaliah.
people.mattan-baal.meaning: The people kill him when they destroy Baal's house.
people.jozacar.meaning: He joins Jehozabad in killing Judah's King Joash.
people.joash-israel.meaning: Israel's king wins back towns from Ben Hadad. He also defeats Judah's King Amaziah.
people.jeroboam-ii.meaning: He expands Israel's land while continuing the worship practices the book condemns.
people.zechariah-king.meaning: Shallum kills him after a reign of six months. His death ends Jehu's royal family.
people.urijah-priest.meaning: He builds a new altar from the design Ahaz sends. He changes temple worship at the king's command.
people.so-egypt.meaning: Hoshea sends messengers to this Egyptian ruler while seeking help against Assyria.
people.rabsaris.meaning: This Assyrian officer joins the force sent to demand Jerusalem's surrender.
people.abi.meaning: Hezekiah's royal family record names her as his mother and Zechariah's daughter.
people.amon-king.meaning: He follows Manasseh's earlier worship practices. His servants kill him after two years as king.
people.hilkiah-priest.meaning: He finds the book of the law during temple repairs.
people.shallum-huldah.meaning: He keeps garments and belongs to the family named with the prophet Huldah.
people.joshua-governor.meaning: Jerusalem's governor is linked with a gate where Josiah removes places of worship.
people.jehoahaz-judah.meaning: Egypt's king removes him after three months and takes him to Egypt.
people.gedaliah.meaning: He urges the remaining people to stay and serve Babylon. Ishmael later kills him.
people.ishmael-nethaniah.meaning: His attack kills Gedaliah and other residents. Fear then drives people toward Egypt.
people.seraiah-captain.meaning: This captain joins the men who meet Gedaliah after Jerusalem falls.
people.evil-merodach.meaning: Babylon's king releases Jehoiachin from prison and gives him regular food.
people.hazael.meaning: His attacks bring suffering to Israel and Judah. He gains power after Ben Hadad's death.
people.solomon.meaning: Josiah removes shrines linked with Solomon's earlier reign.
people.moses.meaning: Hezekiah destroys the bronze serpent Moses made. Josiah later acts on the law linked with Moses.
people.hoshea.meaning: He seeks help from Egypt and stops paying Assyria. His capture comes before Samaria's fall.
people.necho.meaning: Egypt's king removes Jehoahaz, appoints Jehoiakim, and demands payment from Judah.
people.jehoiakim.meaning: He collects money for Egypt's demands. Later, he rebels against Babylon.
people.jehoiachin.meaning: He surrenders to Babylon and lives in captivity. A later king gives him food and honor.
people.nebuchadnezzar.meaning: His armies take people and treasure from Judah. Babylon later destroys Jerusalem.
chapters.15.title: Kings rise and fall as Assyria gains power
chapters.18.title: Hezekiah changes worship and faces Assyria
chapters.18.summary: Hezekiah removes shrines and the bronze serpent. Sennacherib captures towns, demands payment, and sends men to threaten Jerusalem.
chapters.21.title: Manasseh and Amon restore forbidden worship
chapters.22.meaning: The king's men seek Huldah's answer about the book. Her warning leads Josiah to change worship.
people.johanan-kareah.meaning: He joins the officers who meet Gedaliah after Jerusalem falls.
